meta.name: ml-paper-writing
meta.description: Write publication-ready ML/AI/Systems papers for NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, AAAI, COLM, OSDI, NSDI, ASPLOS, SOSP. Use when drafting papers from research repos, structuring arguments, verifying citations, or preparing camera-ready submissions. Includes LaTeX templates, reviewer guidelines, and citation verification workflows.

copy.tagline: 将研究代码转化为顶会论文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在撰写机器学习或系统领域的学术论文。
copy.tagline_en: Turn research code into top-tier conference papers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing academic papers in ML/AI/Systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据研究仓库自动撰写完整的机器学习论文草稿，包括摘要、引言、方法、实验、相关工作等部分，并验证引用文献的真实性。
howto.when: 当你从研究仓库开始起草论文、需要组织论证、验证引用或准备最终提交时触发。

say.text: 帮我根据这个代码仓库写一篇NeurIPS论文初稿。
say.note: Claude会探索仓库并生成完整草稿。

say.text: 验证这篇论文的引用是否真实，并补充相关文献。
say.note: Claude会搜索并核实引用，标记无法确认的条目。

say.text: 把这篇论文格式改成ICML的模板。
say.note: Claude会转换格式并调整内容以符合会议要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically draft complete machine learning papers from research repositories, including abstract, introduction, methods, experiments, and related work, and verify citation authenticity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start drafting a paper from a research repo, need to structure arguments, verify citations, or prepare camera-ready submissions.

say_en.text: Write a NeurIPS paper draft based on this code repository.
say_en.note: Claude will explore the repo and generate a full draft.

say_en.text: Verify the citations in this paper and find related literature.
say_en.note: Claude will search and verify citations, marking unverifiable ones.

say_en.text: Reformat this paper for ICML submission.
say_en.note: Claude will convert format and adjust content for the venue.
